releaseNotes: Audio-only sources can now be synced (select audio OR video clips — a source is a source); audio sources land on their own audio tracks. Panel now auto-checks for updates every time it opens. Matching sensitivity High/Max now adds a second onset-based (spectral-flux) detection method to dig matches out of music/noise-heavy audio (Normal unchanged). Voice-note mic: added CEF media flags + clearer macOS permission guidance. 'by Nick M' credit moved to the bottom of Settings.
